steps: 1. Open netflix.com or the Netflix app and log in to your account.
2. Click your Profile icon at the top-right corner and select 'Account'.
3. Under the 'Membership & Billing' section, click the blue 'Cancel Membership' button.
4. Click 'Finish Cancellation' to confirm.
5. Your access will remain active until the end of your current billing period.
1. Go to spotify.com/account on your web browser and log in.
2. Under 'Your plan', click 'Change plan'.
3. Scroll down to 'Spotify Free' and click 'Cancel Premium'.
4. Click 'Yes, cancel' to confirm cancellation.
5. You will retain Premium features until your next billing cycle date.
1. Log in to Amazon.in on your web browser.
2. Hover over 'Account & Lists' at top right and select 'Your Prime Membership'.
3. Click 'Manage Membership' (top right section).
4. Click 'End Membership and Benefits'.
5. Confirm by selecting 'Continue to Cancel' and then 'Cancel Membership'.
1. Open Disney+ Hotstar website or app and log in with your registered phone number.
2. Go to 'My Account' or click your profile avatar.
3. Select 'Subscription Details'.
4. Click 'Cancel Subscription' or 'Turn off Auto-Renewal'.
5. Confirm your cancellation when prompted.
1. Open youtube.com or the YouTube app and tap your profile picture.
2. Select 'Purchases and memberships'.
3. Tap on 'Individual membership' or 'Family membership'.
4. Select 'Deactivate' or 'Cancel membership'.
5. Select your reason for leaving and click 'Continue to cancel'.
1. Open the Swiggy Mobile App.
2. Go to the 'Account' tab at the bottom right.
3. Tap on 'Swiggy One Membership'.
4. Scroll down and select 'Manage Membership'.
5. Toggle off 'Auto-Renewal' or tap 'Cancel Subscription'.
1. Open the Zomato Mobile App.
2. Tap your profile picture at the top right corner.
3. Select 'Zomato Gold' membership banner.
4. Scroll down to membership settings and select 'Manage Plan'.
5. Select 'Cancel Membership' / Disable Auto-Renewal.
1. Open jiocinema.com or the JioCinema App and log in.
2. Click the Profile / More icon.
3. Select 'My Subscription' or 'Account'.
4. Click 'Cancel Subscription'.
5. Confirm cancellation when prompted.
1. Open sonyliv.com or SonyLIV app and sign in.
2. Go to 'My Account' or profile settings.
3. Select 'Active Subscriptions'.
4. Click 'Unsubscribe' or 'Cancel Auto-Renewal'.
5. Follow the prompt to complete cancellation.
1. Go to zee5.com or open ZEE5 app and log in.
2. Click 'My Account' $\rightarrow$ 'My Subscription'.
3. Click 'Cancel Subscription'.
4. Confirm cancellation on the confirmation screen.
1. Open 'Settings' on your iPhone or iPad.
2. Tap your Name / Apple ID at the top.
3. Tap 'Subscriptions'.
4. Select the active subscription you want to cancel.
5. Tap 'Cancel Subscription' (or 'Cancel Free Trial') and confirm.
1. Open the Airtel Thanks Mobile App.
2. Tap on 'Services' or 'Manage'.
3. Select your active pack or digital subscription.
4. Tap 'Manage' $\rightarrow$ 'Cancel Subscription / Auto-Renew'.
5. Alternatively, call 121 from your Airtel number to request cancellation.
